```{r, include = F}
library(lme4)
library(marginaleffects)
library(tidyverse)
library(tinythemes)
theme_set(tinythemes::theme_ipsum_rc()+
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 0,  # Top margin
                             r = 0,  # Right margin
                             b = 0,  # Bottom margin
                             l = 0))
)
```


```{r, include=F}
d = read_tsv(here::here("_data/posts.tsv.gz")) |> 
  filter(timestamp >= as.Date("2025-03-15")) |> 
  filter(timestamp < as.Date("2025-04-15")) |> 
  mutate(outlet = paste(brand, country))

regions = read_csv(here::here("_data/regions.csv")) |> 
  rename(country = Market, region = Region)

d = d |> 
  left_join(regions, by = "country")
```
